intro.text: A region of southwestern Roshar that was part of Makabakam in the time of the Silver Kingdoms.
A landlocked princedom in southwestern Roshar, a member state of the Azish Empire, ruled by a princess.

description.text: Yezier has no Oathgate. Like other member states of the empire, it can ordinarily borrow Azir's imperial Shardblades.
Yezier is famed for its stormwardens and timekeepers.
Together with neighbouring Liafor, Yezier has for decades been one of the places that set fashion for all of Roshar.
As a member of the Azish Empire, Yezier answers to the Prime Aqasix, but it has rulers of its own, at present a princess.
Yezier has long had close ties to the Azish throne, and its princess spends half of each year in Azimir.

It borders Desh to the north, Azir to the east and Tashikk and Liafor to the south, with a river along its western border with Alm and the Misted Mountains, beyond which lies Shinovar, in the northeast. It has no other major rivers and no notable settlements.

items.text: Yezier is famed for its stormwardens and timekeepers.
Together with neighbouring Liafor, Yezier has for decades been one of the places that set fashion for all of Roshar.

After the Everstorm, Dalinar tried to win Yezier over to his coalition, hoping it would sway other states nearby. Its princess held back, waiting for the Prime Aqasix to decide. Once Azir agreed to join, Yezier followed, and the princess came to Urithiru in person.

When the Azish withdrew from the coalition shortly before the Battle of Thaylen Field, Yezier, fearful of an invasion from Iri, stayed, and the princess sought closer ties between her country and Alethkar.
The princess entered a courtship with Halam Khal, a highlord of House Kholin, though she needs the Prime's permission to marry him.

told.title: Part of Makabakam
told.text: In the age of the Silver Kingdoms, Yezier belonged to Makabakam.

told.title: Waiting on Azir
told.text: After the Everstorm, Dalinar Kholin tried to bring Yezier into his coalition, hoping it would win over other states nearby. He spoke with its princess, but she held back until the Prime Aqasix had decided.

told.title: A plea in Urithiru
told.text: Yezier's princess came to Urithiru in person to ask for help against a feared invasion from Iri.

told.title: Joining the coalition
told.text: Dalinar had hoped Yezier would help sway its neighbours, but its princess waited on the Prime Aqasix. Once Azir agreed to join the coalition, Yezier did too, and the princess came to Urithiru herself.

told.title: Staying with Alethkar
told.text: The Azish pulled out of the coalition not long before the battle of Thaylen Field, but Yezier stayed. Its princess, who had feared an invasion from Iri, now on Odium's side, looked to bind herself and her country more closely to Alethkar.

told.title: A Kholin courtship
told.text: The princess began courting Halam Khal, a highlord of House Kholin, though she may not marry him without the Prime Aqasix's leave.
